note: Hand-kept. Every rule needs an official source_url and the date a person last checked it (verified_on). No source, no rule: trips without a rule show 'Stav chodníka neoverený', never 'otvorené'. 'selector' is read only by the pipeline (pipeline/rules.py): a trip gets the rule when it lies in bbox [w,s,e,n] and its path passes within 150 m of a named place in 'probes', or uses a hiking route whose ref is in 'route_refs'. Check the TANAP visitor rules (návštevný poriadok) every autumn.
